current_state.headline: Iranian Drones Hit Kuwait Airport as Gulf Infrastructure Crisis Deepens
current_state.they_say: US-Iran strikes are contained to military targets — civilian infrastructure not at risk.
current_state.reality: Kuwait International Airport struck by Iranian drones on June 3. Civilian infrastructure targeting threshold crossed. Kuwait operations remain suspended as of June 4.
current_state.thesis: Energy corridor infrastructure targeting threshold crossed. Brent repricing accelerates as Gulf state positioning shifts.

current_state.headline: Brent Breaks $78 as Gulf Tanker Rates Spike 40% on War Risk
current_state.they_say: The oil risk premium is already priced in at current levels — limited upside from here.
current_state.reality: Brent opens gap-up at $78. Gulf tanker war risk premiums surge 40% in 24h. Insurance costs for Strait of Hormuz transit are repricing at levels last seen in 2019 Abqaiq-Khurais attack.
current_state.thesis: Crude futures lagging the physical market — war risk insurance and tanker rates are the leading indicator for a sustained $80+ Brent.

current_state.headline: GCC Emergency Meeting — Gulf State Positioning Shifts
current_state.they_say: Gulf states remain unified in diplomatic response with measured military posture.
current_state.reality: GCC emergency meeting called. Saudi Arabia and UAE signal potential divergence on energy corridor security posture. Qatar offers mediation.
current_state.thesis: Gulf state positioning shifts as internal fractures emerge over energy corridor security response.
